description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Puppeteer Clique.
When Puppeteer Clique dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil, Blasting Station and Puppeteer Clique trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Thran Vigil trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Puppeteer Clique.
Resolve the Puppeteer Clique trigger, allowing you to put a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.
